reason: The analyst reports a bivariate OLS with no controls (2.23 after trimming the outcome's tails). My analysis shows this is confounded: adding the 2020 pre-period controls cuts the effect to about 0.69 (SE 0.24), so the analyst overstates the magnitude roughly threefold. The report also tried only one specification and gave no justification for omitting controls or for trimming the outcome.
